commands.name: dot help
commands.desc: CLI overview of dotfiles commands and keybindings
commands.details:
Shows all available commands and keybindings.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot help          Interactive fzf view
  dot help --plain  Text output without fzf
  dot               Alias for dot help
  dot h             Short form

━━━ Features ━━━
• Filters by enabled feature flags
• Enter executes selected command
• Preview shows details on the right

━━━ Dependencies ━━━
• jq (JSON processing)
• fzf (optional, for interactive view)

commands.name: dot doctor
commands.details:
Checks the dotfiles installation for common issues.

━━━ What is checked? ━━━
• Git repository: existence and status
• Submodules: initialized and up-to-date?
• Symlinks: ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.tmux.conf
• Tools: fzf, jq, tmux, etc.
• MOTD timers: systemd status

━━━ Status symbols ━━━
  OK    All good
  WARN  Unusual but works
  FAIL  Missing or broken
  INFO  Informational

━━━ Example ━━━
  dot doctor

commands.name: dot profile
commands.details:
Measures loading time for each dotfiles component.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot profile       Profile all components
  dot prof          Short form

━━━ Output ━━━
• Components sorted by load time (slowest first)
• Visual bar chart showing relative time
• Color coding: green <20ms, yellow <100ms, red >100ms

━━━ Performance tips ━━━
• Components >100ms are considered slow
• Consider lazy-loading for rarely-used features
• Check if slow components have missing dependencies

━━━ Full startup time ━━━
  time bash -i -c exit
  time zsh -i -c exit

commands.name: dot reload
commands.details:
Reloads the shell RC file and clears the screen.

━━━ Behavior ━━━
• Bash: source ~/.bashrc
• Zsh:  source ~/.zshrc
• Fallback to ~/dotfiles/bashrc or zshrc

━━━ When to use? ━━━
• After changes to dotfiles
• After dot update
• After feature flag changes

━━━ Keybinding ━━━
  Alt+R  (if DOTFILES_ENABLE_RELOAD_BINDING=true)

commands.name: dot install
commands.details:
Starts the interactive installation menu.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot install       Interactive menu
  dot i             Short form

━━━ Installation options ━━━
• Create symlinks (bashrc, zshrc, etc.)
• Initialize git submodules
• Install fzf
• Setup MOTD systemd timers
• Install dependencies via apt

━━━ Non-interactive ━━━
  bash ~/dotfiles/install.sh all

commands.name: dot update
commands.details:
Updates dotfiles to the latest version.

━━━ What happens? ━━━
  1. git pull --ff-only
  2. git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot update        Full update
  dot u             Short form

━━━ After update ━━━
  dot reload        Reload shell
  dot doctor        Check installation

━━━ Note ━━━
Only fast-forward merges. For conflicts,
merge manually with git pull.

commands.name: dot cd
commands.details:
Changes to the dotfiles directory.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot cd
  pwd  →  /home/<user>/dotfiles

━━━ Useful for ━━━
• Quick editing of configuration
• Git operations in dotfiles repo
• Adjusting cheats or aliases

commands.name: dot modules
commands.details:
Shows all git submodules with sync status.

━━━ Status symbols ━━━
  ✓  Synchronized with index
  ↑  Modified / different commit
  ✗  Not initialized
  !  Merge conflict

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot modules       Full command
  dot mod           Short form

━━━ Submodules ━━━
• modules/fzf              Fuzzy Finder
• modules/fzf-tab-completion
• modules/oh-my-tmux       Tmux Config
• modules/oh-my-zsh        Zsh Framework
• modules/tpm              Tmux Plugin Manager
• modules/vimrc            Vim Configuration

commands.name: dot env
commands.details:
Lists all DOTFILES_* environment variables.

━━━ Color coding ━━━
  green  = true  (enabled)
  red    = false (disabled)
  yellow = other values

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot env

━━━ Important variables ━━━
• DOTFILES_ENABLE_*    Feature flags
• DOTFILES_OS          linux/darwin
• DOTFILES_DISTRO_ID   ubuntu/debian/...
• DOTFILES_WSL         0/1
• DOTFILES_WSL_VERSION 0/1/2
• DOTFILES_CONTAINER   0/1
• DOTFILES_PROMPT_STYLE classic/compact

━━━ Debugging ━━━
Helps find out why a feature
is not working.

commands.name: dot cache remove
commands.details:
Deletes the MOTD widget cache.

━━━ Cache directory ━━━
  ~/.cache/dotfiles/motd/

━━━ When to use? ━━━
• Widget shows stale data
• After configuration changes
• On widget errors

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot cache remove

commands.name: dot alias
commands.details:
Shows all aliases defined in the current shell.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dot alias           List all aliases
  dot alias <filter>  Filter by name or value
  dot aliases         Alternative name

━━━ Examples ━━━
  dot alias git       Show git-related aliases
  dot alias docker    Show docker aliases
  dot alias ll        Find specific alias

━━━ Output format ━━━
  name                 command

━━━ Alias sources ━━━
• ~/dotfiles/alias/alias
• ~/dotfiles/alias/alias-*
• ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc

commands.name: sshp
commands.details:
Select a host from ~/.ssh/config via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  sshp              Select host
  Ctrl+S            Keybinding (if enabled)

━━━ Features ━━━
• Reads hosts from ~/.ssh/config
• Preview shows host configuration
• Enter connects directly

━━━ Example ~/.ssh/config ━━━
  Host server1
    HostName 192.168.1.10
    User admin
    Port 22

commands.name: gco
commands.details:
Select a branch/tag via fzf and checkout.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gco               Select branch/tag

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows local and remote branches
• Shows tags
• Preview: recent commits of branch

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  git checkout <branch>

commands.name: gshow
commands.details:
Select a commit via fzf and show details.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gshow             Select commit

━━━ Features ━━━
• Commit history as list
• Preview: diff of commit
• Enter: full git show

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  git show <commit>

commands.name: gaddp
commands.details:
Select modified files via fzf to stage.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gaddp             Select files

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows modified/untracked files
• Preview: diff of file
• Tab: multi-select
• Enter: git add for selection

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  git add <files>

commands.name: gstashp
commands.details:
Select a stash via fzf and perform action.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gstashp show      Show stash
  gstashp apply     Apply stash (keep)
  gstashp pop       Apply stash (delete)
  gstashp drop      Delete stash

━━━ Features ━━━
• List of all stashes
• Preview: stash content
• Enter: execute action

commands.name: gfixup
commands.details:
Create a fixup commit for selected commit.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gfixup            Select commit

━━━ What happens? ━━━
  git commit --fixup=<commit>

━━━ After that ━━━
  git rebase -i --autosquash

━━━ When to use? ━━━
Small corrections to older commits
before pushing.

commands.name: gcp
commands.details:
Copy commit hash to clipboard.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  gcp               Select commit

━━━ Clipboard tools ━━━
• Linux Wayland: wl-copy
• Linux X11: xclip
• macOS: pbcopy

━━━ Useful for ━━━
• Preparing cherry-pick
• Referencing commit in issue/PR
• Preparing revert

commands.name: fh
commands.details:
Search shell history via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  fh                Search history
  Ctrl+R            Keybinding (replaces reverse-i-search)

━━━ Features ━━━
• Fuzzy search in history
• Enter: execute command
• Sorted by frequency/recency

━━━ History file ━━━
• Bash: ~/.bash_history
• Zsh:  ~/.zsh_history

commands.name: cdf
commands.details:
Select a directory via fzf and cd into it.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  cdf               Select directory
  Alt+C             Keybinding

━━━ Features ━━━
• Searches recursively from current directory
• Preview: directory contents (ls/tree)
• Enter: cd into selected directory

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_FZF_CDF_BINDING=true

commands.name: ts
commands.details:
Select a tmux session via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  ts                Select session

━━━ Features ━━━
• List of all sessions
• Preview: windows of session
• Enter: switch-client to session

━━━ Requirement ━━━
Must be run inside tmux.

commands.name: tw
commands.details:
Select a tmux window via fzf (all sessions).

━━━ Usage ━━━
  tw                Select window
  Ctrl+F            Keybinding (inside tmux)

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows windows from all sessions
• Format: session:window
• Preview: pane content
• Enter: focus window

━━━ Requirement ━━━
Must be run inside tmux.

commands.name: tp
commands.details:
Select a tmux pane via fzf (all sessions).

━━━ Usage ━━━
  tp                Select pane

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows panes from all sessions/windows
• Format: session:window.pane
• Preview: pane content
• Enter: focus pane

━━━ Requirement ━━━
Must be run inside tmux.

commands.name: sctl
commands.details:
Interactive systemd service manager via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  sctl              Select service

━━━ Actions (after selection) ━━━
  start     Start service
  stop      Stop service
  restart   Restart service
  reload    Reload configuration
  enable    Enable autostart
  disable   Disable autostart
  status    Show status
  logs      Show logs
  follow    Follow logs live

━━━ Features ━━━
• Preview: status + recent logs
• Uses sudo automatically when needed
• Only available on systemd systems

commands.name: jctl
commands.details:
Select a systemd unit and show logs.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  jctl              Select unit, show logs
  jctl follow       Select unit, follow logs

━━━ Features ━━━
• List of all systemd units
• Shows last 500 lines
• Uses lnav if installed

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  journalctl -u <unit> -n 500
  journalctl -u <unit> -f

commands.name: lctl
commands.details:
Select a macOS service and show logs.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  lctl              Select service, show logs
  lctl follow       Select service, stream logs

━━━ Services ━━━
• Homebrew Services (brew services)
• LaunchDaemons (launchctl)

━━━ Log sources ━━━
• Unified Logging (log show/stream)
• ~/Library/Logs/Homebrew/
• /usr/local/var/log/

━━━ macOS only ━━━
Enabled via DOTFILES_ENABLE_LOG_PICKER

commands.name: dps
commands.details:
Select a Docker container via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dps               Select container

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows all containers (running + stopped)
• Preview: recent logs
• Uses sudo if needed

━━━ Displayed ━━━
ID, Name, Image, Status, Ports

commands.name: dexec
commands.details:
Select container and open shell inside.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dexec             Open shell (bash/sh)
  dexec bash        Explicitly bash
  dexec sh          Explicitly sh
  dexec <cmd>       Run any command

━━━ Features ━━━
• Only running containers
• Default: bash --login (fallback: sh)
• Interactive with TTY (-it)

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  docker exec -it <container> <cmd>

commands.name: dlogs
commands.details:
Select container and show logs.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dlogs             Show logs (~500 lines)
  dlogs follow      Follow logs live

━━━ Features ━━━
• All containers (running + stopped)
• Uses lnav if installed
• Preview: last 50 lines

━━━ Equivalent ━━━
  docker logs <container>
  docker logs -f <container>

commands.name: cheat
commands.details:
Search help for a command/topic.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  cheat <topic>     Show help

━━━ Search path (priority) ━━━
  1. ~/dotfiles/cheats/*.cheat
  2. cheat.sh/<topic> (online)
  3. tldr <topic> (if installed)

━━━ Examples ━━━
  cheat tar
  cheat git
  cheat docker

commands.name: dcheat
commands.details:
Select local cheatsheets via fzf.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  dcheat            Select cheatsheet
  dcheat <query>    Start with search term

━━━ Directory ━━━
  ~/dotfiles/cheats/*.cheat

━━━ Features ━━━
• Preview: cheatsheet content
• Uses bat for syntax highlighting
• Over 60 local cheats available

commands.name: helpme
commands.details:
Shows best available help for a command.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  helpme <command>  Show help

━━━ Search path (priority) ━━━
  1. Local cheatsheet
  2. <command> --help
  3. man <command>

━━━ Examples ━━━
  helpme rsync
  helpme find
  helpme awk

commands.name: extract
commands.details:
Extracts archives of various formats.

━━━ Usage ━━━
  extract <file>

━━━ Supported formats ━━━
  .tar.gz, .tgz     tar + gzip
  .tar.bz2, .tbz2   tar + bzip2
  .tar.xz           tar + xz
  .tar              tar
  .gz               gzip
  .bz2              bzip2
  .xz               xz
  .zst, .zstd       zstd
  .zip              zip
  .rar              rar
  .7z               7zip

━━━ Note ━━━
Requires appropriate tools (unzip, 7z, etc.)

bindings.name: Ctrl+H
bindings.details:
Opens the interactive dot help menu.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_DOT_HELP=true
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_DOT_HELP_BINDING=true

━━━ Note ━━━
Ctrl+H may be interpreted as Backspace
in some terminals.

bindings.name: Alt+R
bindings.details:
Reloads shell configuration.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Behavior ━━━
• Clears screen
• Sources ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc
• Fallback to ~/dotfiles/*rc

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_RELOAD_BINDING=true

━━━ When to use? ━━━
• After changes to dotfiles
• After feature flag changes

bindings.name: Ctrl+R
bindings.details:
Replaces standard history search with fzf.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Before (standard) ━━━
  reverse-i-search (incremental)

━━━ After (fzf) ━━━
• Fuzzy search
• Preview possible
• Multiple matches visible at once

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_FZF_HISTORY_BINDINGS=true

bindings.name: Ctrl+F
bindings.details:
Opens tmux window picker (only inside tmux).

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh (only inside tmux)

━━━ Features ━━━
• Shows all windows from all sessions
• Preview: pane content
• Fast switching between windows

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_TMUX_FZF=true

━━━ Note ━━━
Overrides forward-char (cursor right).
Only active when $TMUX is set.

bindings.name: Ctrl+G
bindings.details:
Opens the Navi cheatsheet menu.

━━━ What is Navi? ━━━
Interactive cheatsheet browser with
executable snippets.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Cheats directory ━━━
  ~/dotfiles/cheats/*.cheat

━━━ Features ━━━
• Over 60 local cheats
• Variables are prompted
• Enter executes snippet

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_NAVI=true

bindings.name: Alt+C
bindings.details:
Changes to a directory selected via fzf.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Features ━━━
• Recursive directory search
• Preview: directory contents
• Fuzzy matching

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_FZF_CDF_BINDING=true

━━━ Alternative ━━━
  cdf  (call manually)

bindings.name: Tab
bindings.details:
Replaces standard tab completion with fzf.

━━━ Shells ━━━
  Bash + Zsh

━━━ Features ━━━
• Fuzzy matching for completions
• Preview for files
• Faster navigation

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_FZF_TAB_COMPLETION=true

━━━ Submodule ━━━
  modules/fzf-tab-completion/

notes.name: Config
notes.details:
Per-host configuration (gitignored).

━━━ Usage ━━━
Override feature flags:

  # Example local_dotfiles_settings
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_AUTOUPDATE=false
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_TMUX_AUTOSTART=false
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_OH_MY_ZSH=true
  DOTFILES_PROMPT_STYLE=compact

━━━ Note ━━━
• File is NOT committed to git repo
• Loaded after components/feature_flags
• Overrides default values

notes.name: Feature flags
notes.details:
All available feature flags with defaults.

━━━ Structure ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_<FEATURE>={true|false}

━━━ Important flags ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_PROMPT          Prompt
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_FZF             fzf integration
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_ALIASES         Alias files
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_MOTD            Message of the Day
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_AUTOUPDATE      Auto-update
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_TMUX_AUTOSTART  Tmux on login

━━━ Show all flags ━━━
  dot env
  grep DOTFILES_ENABLE components/feature_flags

notes.name: Prompt style
notes.details:
Configure prompt style.

━━━ Available styles ━━━

  classic (default)
  ┌[12:34:56] ssh:user㉿host (192.168.1.1): ~/dir (755) [git:main *+] [sudo]
  └─$ 

  compact
  ┌── user㉿host: ~/dir [git:main *]
  └─$ 

━━━ Configuration ━━━
In local_dotfiles_settings:
  DOTFILES_PROMPT_STYLE=compact

━━━ Prompt elements ━━━
• Time (classic only)
• SSH indicator + IP
• User㉿Host (💀 for root)
• Directory + permissions
• Git: branch, status, upstream
• Sudo indicator
• Exit code colors ┌└ red

notes.name: MOTD Widgets
notes.details:
Extensible widget system for MOTD.

━━━ Built-in widgets ━━━
• docker     Container statistics
• tailscale  Tailscale IP
• wireguard  WireGuard status
• proxmox    VM/LXC overview
• homebrew   Available updates
• network    Host reachability

━━━ Custom widgets ━━━
Directory: ~/dotfiles/motd/widgets/<hostname>/

Format:
  #!/bin/bash
  echo "label:value"

Make executable:
  chmod +x widget.sh

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_MOTD_WIDGETS=true

━━━ Clear cache ━━━
  dot cache remove

notes.name: Aliases
notes.details:
Shell alias definitions by category.

━━━ Alias files ━━━
  alias           Main aliases
  alias-docker    Docker commands
  alias-git       Git commands
  alias-systemctl Systemctl shortcuts
  alias-proxmox   Proxmox VE commands
  alias-wireguard WireGuard VPN
  alias-glusterfs GlusterFS
  alias-iobroker  ioBroker Smart Home
  alias-navi      Navi cheat widget

━━━ Configuration ━━━
  DOTFILES_ENABLE_ALIASES=true

━━━ Custom aliases ━━━
In alias/alias or local_dotfiles_settings

notes.name: Cheats
notes.details:
Local cheatsheets in Navi format.

━━━ Count ━━━
  60+ cheatsheets

━━━ Categories ━━━
• Shells: bash, zsh, fish
• Tools: git, docker, tmux, vim
• System: systemd, networking, disk
• Languages: python, javascript, go
• Cloud: kubernetes, terraform

━━━ Usage ━━━
  Ctrl+G    Navi menu
  dcheat    fzf picker
  cheat X   Direct search

━━━ Format ━━━
  % category, subcategory
  # Description
  command <arg1> <arg2>
